overview: The Board of Health approved a food safety variance for a local restaurant and discussed the recruitment process for a new public health nurse. The Board also reviewed plans for utilizing upcoming opioid settlement funds for prevention and recovery support.

items.title: Approval of minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the January 17 meeting.

items.title: Matsuba sushi rice variance request
items.summary: Approved a variance for the acidification of sushi rice at Matsuba after reviewing the establishment's HACCP plan and standard operating procedures for pH monitoring.

items.title: Staffing and opioid settlement updates
items.summary: Director O'Connor announced the vacancy of the public health nurse position and discussed the status of opioid settlement funds, which will involve community listening sessions and City Council appropriation.
